chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام, when he fasted, would not smell الريحان, so he was asked about that, and he said:
"I dislike mixing my fast with pleasure."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.صَامَ: observed sawm; entered the state of fasting

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام avoid smelling basil while fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام during fasting, as he avoided smelling fragrant herbs out of dislike for combining his sawm with sensual pleasure. It reflects an ethic of spiritual refinement and self-restraint within the state of fasting.
